bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
new=create-videobot:invoice-only-9b1075b0
test -n "$(docker image inspect "$new" --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 41
out="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$out"' EXIT
set +e
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node "$new" --test test/paidListingPublisher.test.mjs test/pgPostingReceipts.test.mjs test/videoInvoiceSales.test.mjs >"$out" 2>&1
rc=$?
set -e
printf 'INVOICE_IMAGE_TEST_EXIT=%s\n' "$rc"
if test "$rc" -ne 0;then
 grep -A 20 -B 2 '^not ok' "$out" | head -110 || true
 tail -n 12 "$out"
 exit 48
fi
echo INVOICE_IMAGE_TEST_PASS
